description: This file defines an abstract class 'PurgeStrategy' within the 'OrangeHRM' HRM system, specifically in the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin'. The class manages the process of purging or deleting data records related to employees, providing methods to initialize with entity info, retrieve a purge service, and fetch matching records based on employee data. It serves as a base class for specific purge strategies in the system.

classes.name: PurgeStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common functionalities for implementing different data purge strategies related to employee records in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor accepting the entity class name and an InfoArray object to initialize the purge strategy.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to define the purge operation for an employee number.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PurgeService, creating a new one if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Generates an array of match criteria based on employee number and entity field mappings.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Fetches entity records from the database matching specific criteria using the purge service.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters associated with this purge strategy.

methods.name: getEntityClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the entity this strategy operates on.

methods.name: getEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Returns the field mapping for the entity.
